character: KitzSki links the historic town of Kitzbühel with Kirchberg, Jochberg, Pass Thurn/Mittersill and the Kitzbüheler Horn in the Kitzbühel Alps. The Hahnenkamm is home to the Streif World Cup downhill, and a 3S tricable gondola links the Hahnenkamm–Pengelstein side with the Jochberg and Resterhöhe sectors. Terrain is mostly blue and red at moderate altitude (about 800–2,000 m).
learning: Search summary: over half of the piste km are rated easy. Reference note: ski schools operate in Kitzbühel and Kirchberg; confirm beginner areas and lessons.
